posts.text: ‘They’ve got nothing to talk about’: Joe blasts Trump’s repeated Obama jabs — At an Ohio rally Wednesday night, President Donald Trump snapped back at former President Barack Obama for poking fun at White House renovations. Joe points out that, rather than counter the former president’s comments on inflation or the ongoing war in Iran, Trump was preoccupied by attacks on White House decor. “They’ve got nothing to talk about,” Joe says of the moment.

Bibi FREAKS: Says ARABS RIGGED ELECTION As He Plans IRAN STRIKE — Krystal and Saagar discuss Bibi losing it claiming Arabs rigged the Israeli elections. Libertarians challenge Trump-backed Republicans, look to shake up midterms beyond GOP-Dem duopoly — Libertarian candidate Jeremy Todd is running for the U.S. House of Representatives in Kentucky's 4th Congressional District after incumbent Rep. Thomas Massie lost the GOP primary.

Houthis hold 37 UN food workers as Trump-backed WFP chief inherits humanitarian crises across globe — Luke Lindberg says 37 World Food Programme employees are detained by Houthis in Yemen, with some separated from families for nearly two years.

Masters winner becomes latest golfer to leave LIV, keeping 'options open' for PGA Tour return — Sergio Garcia announced his return to the DP World Tour and hinted at a possible PGA Tour comeback as LIV Golf's Chapter 11 bankruptcy deepens.

Fox News ‘Antisemitism Exposed’ Newsletter: Trump's point man in the fight against Jew hate — Fox News' "Antisemitism Exposed" newsletter brings you stories on the rising anti-Jewish prejudice across the U.S. and the world.

Inflation heats up again, days before midterm elections — Rising gas prices drove much of the inflation increase as renewed violence in the Middle East has kept oil prices above $100 a barrel, up from below $70 before the Iran war. But prices also rose outside of fuel costs.

DoorDash strikes $17B deal for rival Instacart in bets on grocery delivery — DoorDash is buying grocery delivery platform Instacart as it looks to expand beyond restaurant delivery and strengthen its position in the U.S. grocery market.

Hegseth fires top Pentagon strategist accused of leaking classified Iran, Ukraine war information — Lt. Gen. Brett Sylvia allegedly failed three polygraph exams tied to classified leaks about the Iran war and Ukraine before Pete Hegseth fired him.

Why Another Iran Strike Looks Inevitable — Can Trump force Tehran into a deal? Foreign policy expert Mike Doran examines the prospects for renewed war and the divisions over America’s role in the Middle East.

Vance Proposes Restarting Peace Talks in Outreach to Iranian Official — In his letter, the vice president suggested an immediate resumption of comprehensive talks, including about Iran’s nuclear program.

Where Does Benjamin Netanyahu Go from Here? — Netanyahu did not win on Tuesday. In pure mathematical terms, he crashed. But he may have done just well enough for his highest priority: bringing down the Iranian regime, writes Haviv Rettig Gur.

Trump administration sanctions North Korean network accused of infiltrating US companies — Treasury sanctioned ten individuals and one entity tied to North Korean IT workers who allegedly used stolen identities to infiltrate U.S. companies.

UAE SECRETLY Helping Houthis WAR On Saudis — Ryan and Emily discuss the UAE secretly helping the Houthis in their war with Saudi Arabia.
